page.layout: One printed page, single column of running text with entries; no marginal notes of text beyond faint show-through from the facing page. Top: page number and running head.

main_text.p: Agere sic res, quomodo patiuntur se agi] Conto navigare.
Agere stulta] Nebulas diverberare. Vid. Inutiliter.
Agere sibi contraria] Calidum & frigidum ex eodem ore effiare.
Ager] Agellus, Cic. Aratio, Cic. Aratiuncula. Plaut.

Agilis] Liv. Velox, Plin. Citus, Virg. Citissimus, Plaut. Citatus. Citatissimus. Concitatus, Liv. Concitatissimus, Quint. Praeceler. Praevelox, Plin. Pernix, Lucr. Plin. Praepes, Cic. Incitus. Incitatus & Incitatissimus, Id. Volucer, & volucris. Rapidus equus, Ovid. Praerapidus, Sil. Mobilis, Lucr. Mens mire mobilis. Effusus cursus, Liv. Expromptus, Ter. Levipes, Var. Pegaseo fertur volatu, Ocyor. Ocyssimus, Plin. Volaticus impetus, Cic. Ales, adnom. Sil.
Agitare perpetuo] Esse in jugi agitatione.
Agnus] Agnellus, Plaut. Agnus tener, Virg. Lactens, Ovid. Novella agna, Id. Avilla, Fest.
Agrarius] Lex agraria, Liv. Agrosus homo, Var. Glebarius bos, Id. Arvales fratres. Sacerdotes pro frugibus arvorum. Sacra procurantes apud Ethnicos.
Agrestis] Silvestris herba (opposita hortensi), Plin. Fera vitis, Silen. Turneb. Scal. Agrestis arbor, Cic. Campester & campestris, Cic. Agrios, Graeca voce saepe utitur Plinius.

Agricola] Arator, Cic. Agricultor. Cultor agrorum, Liv. Cultor terrae, Cic. Liv. Colonus, Cic. Virg. Moderator aratri, Lucr. Politor (scil. agrorum) Cato Vlp. Subarator, Plin. Sulcator, Silius transtulit alio. Obstetricator terrae. Foenerator Deo. Imporcitor, Fest.
Agricolaris] Georgicus. Colonius, Col. Agricolare opus, Pallad. Aratricus, Varr. Aratrica corona.
Agricultura] Agricultura nil dulcius, Cic. Doctores agricolationis non cognovi, Col. Agricultio, Cic. Ars agriculturae, Varr. Rusticationis scientia.
Ah!] Aha, Plaut. Eheu, Cic. Hei, heu, Atat, Ter. Pro vel Proh, Ovid. vid. Heu Miserum.
Ajunt] Traditur, Cic. Liv. Fertur, Cic. Virg. Produnt.

page.notes: Scan is a faint, slightly skewed page; some entries are partly obscured by show-through from the facing page, which was omitted. Greek word "Agrios" and some abbreviations (e.g. "Vlp.", "Silen.") are as printed. Entry "Agrestis" reads "opposita" with a Cyrillic-looking a in the transcription; it should be Latin "opposita" as printed, uncertain [?] applies to the letter forms.
